evidence: reg:social/schedule (GET answers 405). src/http/social-studio-screen.test.mjs only tests the page; no test imports the handler. gap-social.mjs social:studio-read reads the posts queue but no check follows a scheduled post. Unsorted in tripwires-baseline.json.

control: GET/POST /api/staff/avatar — an employee's own profile photo: POST stores a PNG or JPEG (sniffed by magic number, 5 MB cap) in the object store and keeps the key on staff.avatar_key; GET streams it back. Acts on the session's own staff id only. Caller: any signed-in staff.
evidence: src/http/staff-avatar.pg.test.mjs drives upload and download through ROUTES on a real database; src/auth/session.test.mjs. reg:staff/avatar. Unsorted in tripwires-baseline.json.

control: GET/PATCH /api/tasks — the staff work queue: GET filters done, client_id, q, role, mine, unclaimed (any staff session may read any role's queue); PATCH {id, done} | {id, claim:true} | {id, assignee_staff_id} needs an open shift unless owner/admin. Caller: any staff session.
evidence: src/http/tasks-write.pg.test.mjs imports the handler on a real database (shift gate, claim, done); src/http/calendar-paint.test.mjs and src/auth/account-session.pg.test.mjs. reg:tasks and slice-30 claim. Several gap lanes read tasks for overdue and unassigned work (gap-csm, gap-documents, gap-handoff) but none follow a PATCH. Unsorted in tripwires-baseline.json.

control: GET /api/trials/dashboard — the live screen a $297 Live Trial buyer watches for a week: counts of booked calls, spend (null when nothing has synced), bookings, plan and events in the trial window; no earnings claims, no lender data. Read-only. Caller: partner (own trial; a partner_id sent is ignored) or staff naming ?partner_id.
evidence: src/http/trials-live.pg.test.mjs imports the handler on a real database. reg:trials/dashboard (the page a paying trial buyer opens). No pulse file reads live_trials. Unsorted in tripwires-baseline.json.

control: POST /api/waypoint-tick {waypoint_id, done} — a client ticks or unticks one step on their own checklist; only steps that stay open until a person says so are tickable (paydown steps and the no-new-credit rule are refused server-side). Pinned to the session's own file, no client_id parameter. Caller: client only.
evidence: src/http/waypoint-tick.pg.test.mjs imports the handler on a real database. reg:waypoint-tick (GET answers 405) and slice-26 claim. gap-portal.mjs reads client_waypoints for a step that should unlock, not whether a tick landed. Unsorted in tripwires-baseline.json.
